title: euphrasia officinalis f. latifolia
intro: Euphrasia officinalis f. latifolia, commonly known as Eyebright, is a flowering plant species native to Europe and Asia, known for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Eyebright include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which help to treat eye infections, conjunctivitis, and other eye-related conditions. The therapeutic actions of Eyebright include its ability to soothe and protect the eyes, reduce inflammation and swelling, and combat bacterial and viral infections. The bioactive constituents of Eyebright include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and iridoid glycosides, which contribute to its therapeutic properties and health benefits.
